key_decisions.decision: Retain both negative choices before their positive counterparts.
Preserve covenant as the ark’s contents without inserting tablets.
Keep every dimension and the change from standing to kneeling.
Make the condition audible without weakening the royal promise.
Retain the question and its escalating contrast.
Leave the oath’s courtroom function without inventing an ordeal.
Preserve judicial contrast and the head image with generic referents.
Keep personal pain within the communal petition.
Use inclusive foreigners while retaining the distinct non-Israelite referent.
Preserve the expansive request and the repeated name motif.
Preserve universal sin and the concrete captivity sequence.
Preserve all four poetic movements and salvation as clothing.
Choose love shown to David while noting the alternative direction.
